title: Compatibility-gated rollforward orchestrator for VPC control plane
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description:
Problem: Private VPC customers need predictable, reversible control plane upgrades. Current manual rollouts are slow and occasionally introduce subtle incompatibilities (CRD schema drift, operator API changes, KV cache key format mismatches) that require hotfixes and customer intervention.

Goal: Build an orchestrator that performs a rollforward (version bump) in phased cohorts gated by an automated compatibility matrix and health probes. The orchestrator will drive Terraform-based IaC changes to customer VPC control planes, apply pre-upgrade compatibility checks, perform a small canary cohort rollout, continuously evaluate health signals, and either promote, pause, or rollback the rollout automatically.

Scope:
- Terraform module extensions for safe rollforward (idempotent version pins, staged var injection, per-cohort state handling).
- Compatibility matrix service (lightweight) that validates operator CRDs, schema migrations, and runtime binary compatibility before any traffic is moved.
- Canary cohort orchestration with traffic routing rules, phased promotion, and automatic rollback triggers.
- Health checks collection: control-plane API liveness, key-value cache integrity probes, end-to-end request latency SLO, database migration status, and control-plane leader elections.
- Observability and diagnostics: structured rollback reasons, linkable runbooks, and GitHub PR integration for auditability.

Non-goals: Full rewrite of Terraform state backend; we will extend existing modules and follow current state patterns. Not handling node-level OS upgrades in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules include a new 'rollforward' plan stage that supports cohort annotations and can perform a dry-run plan for a cohort
Compatibility checks run as a preflight step and fail fast with clear logs if CRD or operator API mismatches are detected
A canary cohort (1% of clusters) can be promoted automatically after 30m of healthy telemetry or paused/rolled back on predefined error signals
Automated rollback produces a PDF/JSON incident artifact with root-cause hints and a link to the failing run's logs/PR
End-to-end test harness in CI that runs on a synthetic private deployment to validate the orchestrator path
notes: Related infra tickets: ENG-31107 (traffic shadowing prototype), ENG-39281 (rollback and compatibility matrix)
Operational playbook stub uploaded to Drive: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Rpw-ops-rollforward (internal access)
Security note: KMS key rotation and secrets access are out-of-scope but must be validated in the security review before GA
comments: 2026-02-26 - Sofia Nguyen: Initial spike completed. Built a quick compatibility checker that validates CRD versions and operator API surfaces using OpenAPI diff. Found 2 customers with CRD versions that will require a client shim; flagged in the compatibility report.

2026-03-02 - Miguel Rivera: Added Terraform module hooks for cohort labels and a 'plan-only' mode. Need to decide state locking semantics for per-cohort apply to avoid write contention on shared state buckets.

2026-03-05 - Priya Sharma (SRE review): Proposed health signals and thresholds. Recommending both rate-based and absolute-error thresholds; suggested adding a KV-integrity probe that verifies prefix eviction behavior after upgrade.

2026-03-08 - Design feedback (Asha Patel): UX for Console rollout page should surface per-cluster preflight results and allow manual override to skip compatibility checks for trusted cohorts. Marked as follow-up PM work.

2026-03-10 - Miguel Rivera: Implemented automatic rollback hooks in the prototype: on >3% error rate or control-plane API 5xx spike for 10min, orchestrator triggers 'apply' to revert TF changes for the cohort and alerts the SRE runbook. Live test scheduled for 2026-03-16 on staging clusters.
